Hi everyone! Thanks for all the suggestions and feedback. I have shipped the following updates for the plugin:


* Scan selected elements only, allowing more control over the elements to organize
* Improved scanning speed and error handling
* Improved display of variable modes

Figma has updated its API for variable mode detection, so the plugin will not filter elements by modes now. It is recommended to select elements of the same mode and scan at a time.

Although I have done extensive testing on my end, it is hard to account for all possible scenarios in a Figma file, so please help give the new version a try and lemme know what you think or report any issues that you find. Thank you very much!
